items.text: The Practice says a signed identifier carries no actor and opening another record by address may not be refused; the Rationale says "a client never receives rows outside it". Both are in one file. | evidence: Lines 36 and 40 of the file. The webshop needed an interceptor (GAPS R14-7).

States `anonymous = true` makes an actor effectively anonymous with no bearer check. Both webshop actors store `anonymous=true`, have a realm and mapped principal, and still answer 401 without a token. Either the rule needs the principal/realm condition, or the runtime differs. | evidence: CLI `graphql actortypes{anonymous principal}`; `curl` 401 on both actors.
The first says enforcement of the flag is not documented; the second says the runtime enforces uniqueness per attribute. | evidence: The two files.

Says every `application_<locale>.json`, hu-HU included, is generated and overwritten unless ignored. The webshop's `application_hu-HU.json` (a new file written by a script, not in `.generator-ignore`) has survived 15 rounds of generation (GAPS R10). The same page recommends an ignored locale file. | evidence: `git ls-files … application_hu-HU.json`; `.generator-ignore` of the customer module.

Does not mention that the generated `application/integration-test/pom.xml` has `<version></version>` for `hu.blackbelt.osgi.i18n:i18n-api`, so the documented command fails (GAPS R12-5). Still present at e35dddd. | evidence: `application/integration-test/pom.xml:226`.

"Whether and when the platform calls [the initializer] is not documented"; init-data-seeding does not name a trigger. GAPS R10-4 remains unanswered. | evidence: The file; no hit in the catalog for a startup hook.

Field order of generated forms/views follows ESM position in a way that puts e.g. Price above Name (GAPS R3-1, R7-10, reported by the project owner as a platform bug). No catalog page; `kb_search` found nothing. | evidence: kb_search "field order container children position esmToUi".

The same page notes that model `Timestamp!now()` uses `defaultZoneId`. Following the recipe gives a fixed offset against model expressions; the webshop had to use the platform zone (`BusinessClock.platformZone()`, GAPS R12-4). | evidence: `BusinessClock.java:25-37`; platform-behavior-reference.md#Time and Time Zones.
Ambiguous: the instance payload identifies the row; old values need a DAO read (what the webshop does). | evidence: `ProductAuditInterceptor.preCall`.
